follow-up time: Until discharge from hospital (duration not specified)
exposure: Delayed feeding (traditional, withheld until passage of flatus)
cohort: 140 women who underwent cesarean section (70 in the early feeding group and 70 in the delayed feeding group)
finding: Early feeding after cesarean section was associated with earlier appearance of bowel sounds and passage of flatus, without any increase in complications.
